text:
mona: Hey team — I'm submitting my resignation today. Last working day will be 2026-06-21. A few APAC-specific offboarding questions: benefits cutover timing, final payroll dates, equity cliff handling, and access deprovision sequencing. cc @lia :wave:
lia (people-ops): Thanks for letting us know, mona. Sad to see you go. Quick q — will you be working through your last day or taking PTO the final week?
josh (engineering): We should schedule a 1:1 KT session for code ownership handoff. I can take the last two days for pairing.
mona: I'll be available through the last day (no PTO). Happy to pair — josh let's set times. Also need clarity on whether our local statutory benefits stop on last day or at month end.
alex (people-ops): For APAC hires there's frequently a month-end cutoff. Can you confirm which country you're in? That affects statutory benefits & tax withholding.
mona: Singapore (on payroll via Redwood APAC entity).
lia (people-ops): Okay SG. Typical flow: statutory benefits contributions stop on your last payroll run; we usually run final pay within 5 business days after the termination effective date. For company-sponsored medical top-ups, we set end-of-coverage to the end of the month unless you request earlier. Would you prefer coverage through 06/30?
mona: Yes please keep coverage through 2026-06-30. Also what's the process for voluntary enrollment options (COBRA-like) — I know COBRA is US-specific.
alex (people-ops): Correct — COBRA applies to US. For SG we provide information on local voluntary plans and a one-time packet with options and contacts. We'll attach the guide to your offboarding checklist.
ritesh (it): On access — typical plan is: disable privileged tokens & admin console access at EOD on last working day, keep Slack & email for 7 calendar days for handover, then full deprovision. Do you need any extended access for project closure?
mona: I might need email until 07/05 to finish vendor invoicing. I won't need repo access after 06/21.
josh (engineering): I'll take repo ownership right after the KT session. Ritesh, confirm we can transfer org ownership and rotate service account keys.
ritesh (it): Yup. Action items I'll run: transfer GitHub ownership to josh, rotate service account keys used by mona's deploy role, and queue SSO deprovision. Planned schedule:
```
/deprovision schedule --user mona --sso-off 2026-06-22 --email-off 2026-07-05 --slack-off 2026-06-28 --badge-deactivate 2026-06-22
```
I'll annotate the ticket with manual exceptions if email kept past 07/05.
lia (people-ops): Please fill the offboard form (link in ops wiki) so payroll & benefits can run final calculations. We'll confirm final paycheck date once payroll processes. Expect final pay within 5 business days of last day, including accrued PTO payout per policy.
mona: Who handles equity cliff/option exercise windows? I'm still pre-vesting on a 4-year schedule.
lia (people-ops): Equity team will send a separate email with exercise window and next steps. Typically there's a 90-day exercise window for termination without cause for US hires; APAC terms vary by grant. We'll loop in comp@ and legal to confirm your grant's terms.
alex (people-ops): We'll schedule an exit interview — please pick a 30-min slot this week. Also confirm passport/badge return: we can provide a prepaid label for the company laptop and badge if you want courier pickup.
mona: Please send label. I'll drop off physical equipment on 06/22 if pickup isn't available.
josh (engineering): For knowledge capture, can you add a short README to the repos you touch (ownership matrix + runbook link)? 10–15 min per repo is fine.
mona: Will do.
it-ops-bot: [ticket #OFF-1247] Created offboarding ticket for mona. Next step: people-ops to approve final payroll & benefits dates.
lia (people-ops): Approved the offboard ticket and set coverage through 2026-06-30 per request. Alex will follow up on equity/legal. Ritesh — please proceed with the deprovision schedule above and confirm when GitHub ownership transferred.
ritesh (it): Noted. I'll update ticket when transfers & key rotations complete.
alex (people-ops): Looping comp/legal now. Expect confirmation on equity window by EOD.
mona: Thanks all — appreciate the smooth coordination.
lia (people-ops): Thanks, mona. We'll keep you posted and attach all paperwork to the offboard ticket. :memo:
